title: Step 1 response-time budgets: declare absolute ms budgets, time a piped first goal, remove the first-goal startup cost

criteria: startup-gate judges absolute millisecond budgets: version and help 30 ms, status 50 ms, a piped first goal's first output 600 ms and completion 750 ms, daemon down and up; the process-spawn floor is reported as context only
plane-bus rendezvous and capability endpoint files are replaced atomically without a per-file flush, removing most of the first goal's tool-registry startup cost
the daemon readiness scan no longer examines plane-bus endpoint metadata (and no longer launches icacls per such file on Windows), while the bus key and real key files stay scanned

the budgets were set from optimized-build measurements on this host (version and help 17-18 ms, status 19-22 ms, first goal 0.25-0.47 s after the flush fix, 1.05-1.55 s before); quiet-host evidence against them follows in docs/step1-acceptance.md under a later task
